name: Default
shortDescription: Hard drive S.M.A.R.T monitoring hub with historical trends and real-world failure thresholds, fed by collectors on your servers and backed by InfluxDB.

alerts.message: This deploys the web hub only and the dashboard stays empty until data arrives. Run the Scrutiny collector on every machine whose disks you want to monitor, with COLLECTOR_API_ENDPOINT set to https://<your domain>.
Scrutiny has no login: anyone who can reach the domain can view the dashboard and post data to its API.
